requirement: After region-a loss recover every acknowledged order/blob; RPO=0, RTO=60 minutes. Failback preserves secondary writes.

recovery_environment.schemas: orders-v1 and blobs-v1; backups and reader use these exact compatible schemas; no transformation is required.
recovery_environment.assets: The orders/blob backups, replay and config=c1 are the complete disaster-sensitive inventory. Data is unencrypted; no key recovery is needed.
recovery_environment.config_contract: c1 supplies the only order-to-blob routing table required to read restored orders. config=true means a surviving region-b c1 backup; config=false means no surviving copy or reconstruction source. No default or alternate route exists.
recovery_environment.identity: restore-role survives in region-b with read/write access to surviving backups, replay and config; the reader image also survives there.
runbook: verify every acknowledged order and blob ID from the acknowledgement manifest
start candidate-v1 reader and verify reads/writes
recovery_environment.retention_semantics: At disaster time all listed snapshots are fresh at age zero; retention expires after retention_hours. No later snapshot or independent archive is produced after region-a loss. recovery_delay_hours is elapsed disaster-to-restore-start time.
recovery_environment.replay_contract: Surviving replay includes every acknowledged order/blob not in the snapshots; replay in region-a is destroyed by this disaster.
recovery_environment.authority: The secondary alone accepts writes during recovery; unchanged primary has none of those writes. Correct failback fences the old primary and replays all secondary writes before promotion.
recovery_environment.exercise_environment: Exercises use the declared version/scenario/result as supplied records. Matching candidate-v1 regional-loss exercise verifies recovered acknowledgement manifest and usable reads/writes; an old-v0 upload-only exercise supplies neither evidence.
